name: immutability-check
title: Contract immutability enforcement
interface: CLI: bash tools/check-immutability.sh [<baseline-ref>]. Fails if any file under contracts/ was modified or deleted relative to the baseline (additions only), or if laws/deprecations.log shrank or was rewritten (append-only). Exits 0 silently when the baseline ref does not exist.
nl_description: The git-native form of prove2me's statement immutability: once published, a contract can never be edited, so partial work composes and no merge arbitration is needed.
